verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes its desktop client source in the public anyproto/anytype-ts GitHub repo, so the code can be read. However, two independent community reports concretely say the repo's license is source-available rather than open source under the Open Source Definition, which contradicts the open-source framing. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of an OSI-approved license for the core app, and independent confirmation that the license is actually open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
